name: Text-removal prerequisite
description: Checks whether text has been extracted and removed before shape reconstruction. It warns about degraded shape detection but never erases text from inside the Layout tool.

fields.name: text_state
fields.description: Reports whether text is removed, still detected, or not yet checked. Removed permits automatic continuation; detected requires an explicit decision; unknown offers a text check.

fields.name: html_text_layer
fields.description: References the editable HTML text layer produced by the Text tool so it can be restored above reconstructed shapes.

fields.name: continue_with_text
fields.description: Records explicit user consent to continue while raster text remains. Enabling this lowers reconstruction confidence and does not remove or modify text.

actions.name: Open Text tool
actions.description: Switches to the Text tool while preserving the current image and layout workflow state.

actions.name: Check for text
actions.description: Runs text detection only to determine prerequisite status; it does not erase text.

actions.name: Continue anyway
actions.description: Allows layout reconstruction with raster text present and marks resulting proposals as lower-confidence.

output.name: prerequisite_result
output.description: Stores prerequisite status, the optional HTML layer reference, user override, and confidence penalty applied downstream.
